name: La Plaza Del Norte
summary: La Plaza Del Norte is a community shopping center located on Northwest Loop 410 in San Antonio, managed by Kite Realty Group. With a 4.6-star rating, it serves as a convenient neighborhood retail destination for northwest San Antonio residents.
demographics: La Plaza Del Norte serves the northwest San Antonio community, attracting a diverse mix of families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area encompasses middle-income households with a strong Hispanic demographic presence, typical of San Antonio's northwest corridor. Shoppers are primarily convenience-oriented, seeking everyday necessities and services within a neighborhood setting, with frequent visits for grocery shopping, dining, and personal services.
description: La Plaza Del Norte is a community shopping center strategically located at 125 Northwest Loop 410 in San Antonio, Texas, serving as a convenient retail destination for the surrounding neighborhoods. Managed by Kite Realty Group, a prominent national real estate investment trust specializing in retail properties, the center benefits from professional property management and leasing expertise. The center's location along Loop 410 provides excellent visibility and accessibility for residents throughout northwest San Antonio. With a solid 4.6-star rating from 240 reviews, La Plaza Del Norte has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. The center operates daily from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM, offering extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of local families and professionals seeking convenient access to retail services and amenities.
